assembly: a chunk with 'region' is the one at local 'key' in ../legacy/<region>; one with 'older_nbt_case' is cases[n].chunk of ../legacy/older.nbt, a gzipped NBT file

chunks.name: 1.14 snapshot between the stage renames, finished

note: 'blocks_sha256' is every cell y 0..255, z and x 0..15 with x fastest, as a state string; 'biomes_sha256' every 4th y, z and x the same way; each 'surfaces_sha256' a heightmap's 256 surface_y answers, x fastest, 'None' for none, for every map the chunk stores
